from icalendar import Calendar, Event
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date
import uuid

# Determine "next Wednesday" (the next upcoming Wednesday strictly after today;
# if today is Wednesday, that means one week from today)
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
print("Today:", today.isoformat(), f"({today.strftime('%A')})")
print("Local timezone:", local_tz)
print("Next Wednesday:", next_wed.isoformat(), f"({next_wed.strftime('%A')})")

cal = Calendar()
cal.add('prodid', '-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN')
cal.add('version', '2.0')
cal.add('calscale', 'GREGORIAN')

event = Event()
event.add('summary', 'Team Meeting')
event.add('description', 'Team meeting on next Wednesday at 3 PM')
event.add('dtstart', datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz))
event.add('dtend', datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 16, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz))
event.add('dtstamp', datetime.now().astimezone())
event.add('uid', f'{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local')
event.add('status', 'CONFIRMED')
event.add('transp', 'OPAQUE')
event.add('sequence', 0)

cal.add_component(event)

with open('team_meeting.ics', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print("ICS written: team_meeting.ics")

import uuid

local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
dt_start_local = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)
dt_end_local = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 16, 0, 0, tzinfo=local_tz)

# Convert to UTC for unambiguous timestamps in the ICS file
dt_start_utc = dt_start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
dt_end_utc = dt_end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
dt_stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')

print("Today:", today.isoformat(), f"({today.strftime('%A')})")
print("Local timezone:", local_tz)
print("Next Wednesday:", next_wed.isoformat(), f"({next_wed.strftime('%A')})")
print("Event (local):", dt_start_local.isoformat(), "->", dt_end_local.isoformat())
print("Event (UTC):", fmt_utc(dt_start_utc), "->", fmt_utc(dt_end_utc))

uid = f'{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local'
lines = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'BEGIN:VEVENT',
    f'UID:{uid}',
    f'DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(dt_stamp)}',
    f'DTSTART:{fmt_utc(dt_start_utc)}',
    f'DTEND:{fmt_utc(dt_end_utc)}',
    'SUMMARY:Team Meeting',
    'DESCRIPTION:Team meeting on next Wednesday at 3 PM',
    'STATUS:CONFIRMED',
    'TRANSP:OPAQUE',
    'SEQUENCE:0',
    'END:VEVENT',
    'END:VCALENDAR',
]

ics_content = '\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n'
with open('team_meeting.ics', 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

print('ICS written: team_meeting.ics')
